title: FOOTBALL | Jardin Gilbert Press Conference - 11/16/26
text: All right, everybody. We've got Jordan. Questions. Steve. >> JJ, obviously defensively you guys kind of got the short end of the stick, a lot of short fields last week. How do you stay locked in and keep playing hard every single down even when maybe the circumstances aren't the best? >> Uh that's just the the beauty of this sport. It's a team sport. So in order for a offense to to win a game they got to score on defense and that's our mentality. No matter where they could be on the two-yard line, our mentality is to go stop them. So regardless on what the situation is, Coach Arnett does an amazing job just to keep us motivated and understand that it's about us. >> Questions. Robbie. >> What's kind of been the the early thoughts watching some Tennessee Tech film? Obviously having a really good season. They have a big physical quarterback that can make the throws. What have you seen from them so far? >> Uh so they're a program who know how to win. Their head coach has won 20 games in the last two seasons, so they know how to win. So just taking that and honoring that and respecting that. Quarterback take care of the ball. I think he has like 20 something touchdowns, only five interceptions. High completion rate. So we don't see the name on the chest. So we just go out there and play and dominate and that's what our job is to do. >> As a sixth-year guy playing your last home game on Saturday, just how do you reflect on your decision to to transfer here for your last year? >> Uh love these guys, bro. I'm glad that Coach Leb has trusted me with the team just to become a leader to lead the guys. Definitely bittersweet. I'm going to miss it. I'm going to miss Starkville. But with all that being said, excited. It's another opportunity to to go out there and perform for the fans and just to do it one more time in Starkville. >> [clears throat] >> Speaking of that, such an experienced guy that's played in the SEC and this might have been a new stop you, but you came in and were were a big part of that room from a leadership perspective. What's been your message to the guys during this stretch uh where they've been struggling your team's been struggling a little bit. What's been your message? >> To don't don't forget your why. So in the beginning of the season like we all kind of stood up and said our why and why we playing and why we playing football just to not forget that to to be motivated to go out there to just to love football and I feel like that's been the biggest message no matter what the circumstances are just go out there and have fun and love football and don't forget your why. >> You come here in January coach Arnett comes back here in January take us through what it's been like dealing with him not just in spring and summer but now that you've had a season with him just your relationship and what kind of coach it's been like to all you guys. >> Uh amazing. Uh you could tell he understands and knows a lot about he's an aggressive style coach and we appreciate him. Um like I was saying earlier about just his message of motivating us to understand that it's about us. It doesn't matter what the the offense does. It doesn't matter what happens on special teams whenever we on the field the there's only one mindset is to keep them out the end zone. >> I know every time you know staff member loses their job mid season you know it's never a good thing. What was the maybe the mood like today with these new coaches on the field with coach Miller and coach Connors? >> Uh like you said it's never easy. Never want to see um someone lose their job. Um we have tons of respect for coach Phil and coach Odom. We will miss them dearly. Um it was but the the energy on the field is was transferred to Tennessee Tech and uh that's the that's what we looking forward to. >> Anything else? All right thank you guys.
